name: open
js: (async()=>{const M=await import('/src/kode/kore/devMount.tsx'); M.mountKoreApp('koogalien'); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,2500)); return !!document.querySelector('.kgx-app')})()

name: hello-world
js: (async()=>{const L=await import('/src/music/localNotes.ts'); const wait=(ms)=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,ms)); const chord=async(ns)=>{ns.forEach(n=>L.playLocal(n,64,true)); await wait(120); ns.forEach(n=>L.playLocal(n,0,false))}; await chord([60,69]); await wait(800); await chord([60,67,72]); await wait(800); await chord([67,72]); await wait(900); const q=(r)=>document.querySelectorAll('.kgx-col:not(.listening):not(.closer) [data-row="'+r+'"]').length; const S=await import('/src/features/koogalien/store.ts'); const s=S.useKoogalien.getState(); return JSON.stringify({gloss:s.sentence&&s.sentence.words.map(w=>w.en).join(' '), code:s.code, ended:s.ended, rows:[q('notes'),q('code'),q('en')], english:[...document.querySelectorAll('.kgx-col [data-row=en]')].map(e=>e.textContent.trim()), sr:document.querySelector('.kgx-sr').textContent})})()

name: hear
js: (async()=>{const wait=(ms)=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,ms)); const b=[...document.querySelectorAll('.kgx-app button')].find(b=>b.textContent.trim()==='Hear it'); b.click(); await wait(300); const seen=[]; for(let i=0;i<20;i++){const p=document.querySelector('.kgx-col.playing'); if(p) seen.push(p.dataset.word); await wait(150)} return JSON.stringify({seen:[...new Set(seen)]})})()

name: edit-code
js: (async()=>{const wait=(ms)=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,ms)); const t=document.querySelector('#kgx-code'); const set=Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLTextAreaElement.prototype,'value').set; set.call(t,'say hello friend.'); t.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true})); await wait(300); return [...document.querySelectorAll('.kgx-col [data-row=en]')].map(e=>e.textContent.trim()).join('|')})()
